meta.title: Getaway Transfers | Antalya & Muğla VIP Transfers
meta.description: Fixed-price, prepaid private transfers from Antalya, Dalaman, Bodrum and Gazipaşa airports to your hotel.

home.heroTitle: Your chauffeur is ready. Your fare is fixed.
home.heroText: Private airport, hotel and intercity transfers across Antalya and Muğla. See your price now, pay by card, and be met by name.
home.why1Text: The price is calculated from the distance when you book and paid in advance. No surprises on the road.
home.why2Text: Every driver's tourism transport licence is checked before they can take a booking.
home.why3Text: Add your flight number and your driver will wait even if your flight is late.
home.why4Text: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before pick-up.
home.how1: Choose your route and date and see the price instantly.
home.how2: Confirm with the code we text you and pay by card.
home.how3: Your driver's name and vehicle appear in your booking.
home.trust2: Meet & greet based on your flight
home.faq1a: From the road distance between the districts of your pick-up and drop-off addresses and the vehicle type. The price is fixed when you book.
home.faq2q: What if my flight is delayed?
home.faq2a: Add your flight number and your driver will follow your landing time and wait for you at no extra cost.
home.faq3a: By credit or debit card when you book, on the secure page of the payment provider. We never store your card details.
home.faq4a: Cancel free of charge up to 48 hours before pick-up. Between 24 and 48 hours you get a 50% refund; within 24 hours there is no refund.
home.ctaTitle: Let your holiday start at the airport.
home.servicesLead: The same care on every trip: on-time pick-up, a clean vehicle and a licensed driver.
home.s1Text: We track your flight and your driver waits at arrivals with your name. No extra charge for delays.
home.s2Text: Quiet, comfortable and punctual travel between meetings, hotels and events.
home.s3Text: Door-to-door private rides between every district in Antalya and Muğla.
home.s4Text: Chauffeured cars for weddings and private events, with time and route planned ahead.
home.fleetLead: Choose the right vehicle for your group and luggage. Your price is calculated instantly for your route.
home.fleetCta: Get a price with this vehicle
home.groupText: Spacious vehicles with room for everyone's luggage. One vehicle, one booking.
home.group3: Meet and greet at the airport
home.group4: Outbound and return in one booking

cancellation.title: Cancellation and refund policy
cancellation.intro: The fare is charged when you book. If you cancel, the refund depends on how long before the first pick-up time you cancel.
cancellation.tier1: 48 hours or more before pick-up: 100% refund.
cancellation.tier2: Between 24 and 48 hours before pick-up: 50% refund.
cancellation.tier3: Less than 24 hours before pick-up: no refund.
cancellation.guarantee: If you bought the full refund guarantee, you get a 100% refund for any cancellation before pick-up. The guarantee fee itself is not refunded.
cancellation.process: Refunds go back to the card you paid with, in the same currency. Depending on your bank it may take a few working days to appear.
cancellation.noShow: There is no refund if the passenger is not at the agreed place and time. For bookings with a flight number, flight delays are taken into account.
cancellation.howTo: You can cancel yourself from "My bookings". The refund amount is shown before you confirm.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.data: Full name, phone number, e-mail address (optional), country, booking and address details, flight number and times, payment transaction references, IP address and activity logs. We never store your card or passport details.
privacy.purpose: To conclude and perform the transfer contract, to let the driver meet you, to process payments and refunds, to issue legally required invoices, for information security and to comply with legal obligations (KVKK art. 5/2-c, ç, f; GDPR art. 6/1-b, c, f). We send marketing messages only with your explicit consent.
privacy.transfer: Only as far as necessary: the driver carrying out the transfer (name and pick-up details), the payment provider, the SMS provider, the e-invoice provider and legally authorised authorities. Our main infrastructure is in Turkey. For address search and route calculation, only the address text you type and coordinates are sent to the mapping service abroad (Google); your name and phone number are not.
privacy.retention: Flight details are deleted 24 hours after the trip. Booking and invoice records are kept for the period required by tax law.
privacy.rights: You have the right to know whether your data is processed, to request information, correction and deletion, and to object (KVKK art. 11, GDPR art. 15-21). Use the data request form or write to {email}.

distanceSales.title: Pre-contract information
distanceSales.service: Service: Private chauffeur transfer on the route, date and vehicle type stated in the booking. The service is performed by our independent driver partners who hold a tourism transport licence.
distanceSales.price: Price: The total shown in the booking summary includes taxes and is charged to your card when you book. No extra charges are taken during the trip.
distanceSales.performance: Performance: The service starts at the date and time stated in the booking.
distanceSales.withdrawal: Right of withdrawal: Under Article 15 of the Turkish Distance Contracts Regulation there is no right of withdrawal for passenger transport services that must be provided on a specific date or period. Cancellation terms are set out in the cancellation and refund policy.
distanceSales.complaints: Complaints: Write to {email}. You may also apply to the consumer arbitration committee or consumer court within the legal limits.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.text: We only use cookies that the site needs to work: session cookies (whether you are logged in) and your language preference. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies, so we do not ask for cookie consent.
cookies.list: ga_at, ga_rt: session (up to 30 days). NEXT_LOCALE: language preference.
